items.title: dbus: enable structuredAttrs

items.content_html:
#549241 stops the D-Bus daemons from searching the system profile, so a package's D-Bus configuration only reaches them once a module lists it in services.dbus.packages.

The packages were selected mechanically: nix-index was queried for every package carrying dbus-1 configuration, hits whose paths are only empty directories or symlinks were dropped, and the remaining names were matched against nixos/modules both as pkgs.NAME references and as mkPackageOption defaults, which text search alone misses. The result was then checked by evaluation: for 45 NixOS configurations, environment.systemPackages was compared against services.dbus.packages and every unregistered package reported. Only systemd stays out, since #549241 registers it itself.

A registration mirrors the statement that installs the package, its conditions and its excludePackages filter included, so environment.plasma6.excludePackages drops a package from both sides. Packages that only reach systemd.packages, services.udev.packages or the X11/Wayland session path stay out, as do those only reachable through xdg.portal.extraPortals, which config/xdg/portal.nix covers.

Merge together with (or after) #549241: on master alone system.path is still a D-Bus search path, so each registered package is found twice.

items.title: nixos/snapserver: add dbus config for avahi

items.content_html:
Closes #303078

On NixOS, D-Bus reads the following paths:

  • /run/current-system/sw/share/dbus-1
  • Paths generated by services.dbus.packages in /etc/dbus-1/{session,system}.conf, which include config.system.path

When a package is added to both environment.systemPackages and services.dbus.packages, the same file will be found in three paths. This is where the "ignoring duplicate name" error comes from.

items.content_html:
Creating this PR as a result of #545966.

While that turned out to be a case of local store corruption it seems like a good idea to guard against invalid configuration since dbus does not handle it gracefully.

This adds a build-time check to ensure all the *.conf files included through makeDBusConf are actually valid XML. While dbus-broker appears to define a DTD it is explicitly not meant for validation.

Validated that this will reject the following configuration:

  services.dbus.packages = [(
    pkgs.runCommand "broken-config" {} ''
      mkdir -p $out/share/dbus-1/system.d

      touch $out/share/dbus-1/system.d/other.conf
    ''
  )];

Result:

items.title: nixos/shairport-sync: fix dbus support

items.content_html:
This combines #549241 and #571158 into one PR against staging-nixos, with follow-up changes on top.

This PR removes system.path as an explicit search path of the D-Bus daemons,
which fixes most of the "Ignoring duplicate name" warnings that we otherwise get with dbus-broker.
The system bus now only reads system services and policies from packages in services.dbus.packages.

With these changes, the session bus will find session services through XDG_DATA_DIRS, which includes both /run/current-system/sw/share and the different user profile dirs.
So services are found for packages that are in either the system profile or the user profile.
A service is still found twice only when the same package is installed in more than one profile (e.g. systemPackages and the HM user profile), or is also linked by HM's dbus.packages.

A module for a package that doesn't add the derivation to either the system or the user profile, will now need to add the derivation to services.dbus.packages to expose its session services.
Packages that ship system services or policies will now always need to be added to services.dbus.packages.

I put up a bunch of PRs that add packages to dbus.packages where needed:

  • #585391
  • #585395
  • #585398
  • #585406
  • #585410
  • #585452
  • #585469
  • #585486
  • #585512
  • #585530

These were found using nix-index, and we will need to check that no new cases
were introduced before we merge this PR.
